`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales, and `LEAD_TIME_DAYS = 6` sits at the top of the file for when you switch suppliers.

Running it against your current `inventory.csv` gives:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend (9 on hand, about 14 needed) and oat milk (30 on hand, 45 needed) are the two that would run dry before a delivery arrived. An empty shelf still shows `OUT`.

An item with exactly 6 days of stock left is not flagged, since it would just last until the delivery. If you'd rather have a cushion, the simplest way is to set the number to 7 or 8.
